topic: Parts and Functions of the Digestive System
key_concepts: The mouth breaks food into smaller pieces through chewing.
The esophagus is a tube that moves food from the mouth to the stomach.
The stomach is a muscular sac that churns and mixes food.
The stomach adds digestive juices or acid to help break down food.
The small intestine is a long, winding tube where most nutrient absorption happens.
Nutrients from digested food are absorbed into the bloodstream in the small intestine.
The large intestine absorbs water from leftover food material.
Undigested food materials become waste and leave the body.
Food moves through the digestive system in the order: mouth, esophagus, stomach, small int
Chewing food properly helps digestion and can prevent stomach discomfort.
The digestive system provides nutrients and energy to the body.
